headline: Public meeting on zoning amendment for Neoen 400 MW BESS (Z-2026-028)
summary: Council holds the statutory public meeting on Zoning By-law Amendment Z-2026-028, which would rezone part of a property adjacent to 752 Concession 2 (Saugeen Township) to permit a 400 MW lithium-ion battery storage facility tied to an IESO contract. Staff recommend the report be received for information; agency and public comments, a site plan, a draft amending by-law and an applicant presentation are attached. No decision on the by-law is on this agenda.
evidence: NEOEN is proposing to establish a 400-megawatt (MW) lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) facility adjacent to 752 CONCESSION 2 (Saugeen Township)

headline: Proposed council resolution on Hydro One Sudbury-Barrie line route selection
summary: Item 15.5 carries a proposed resolution on the roughly 300 km, 500 kV Sudbury-Barrie Transmission Line Class EA. It would ask Hydro One to explain how the study area was narrowed, share mapping and GIS data, and consult the Township before a preferred route is chosen, and would state opposition to a route through the Township with significant and avoidable impacts. The agenda shows it as a proposed resolution; the outcome of the vote is not in this document.
evidence: Council expresses its strong opposition to any proposed transmission route through the Township of The Archipelago that results in significant and avoidable impacts

headline: Hydro One presents Sudbury-Barrie line route alternatives; Seguin opposition resolution received
summary: Item 18.10 lists a Hydro One environmental planner on the Sudbury Barrie Transmission Line Project route alternatives, a Seguin Township resolution titled as opposing the proposed route, and minutes and agendas from the SBTL Task Force (meetings of Sept 23, Oct 21 and Nov 16). The agenda gives no recommendation text for these items.
evidence: Opposition to Proposed Route of Barrie to Sudbury Transmission Line

headline: Mayor's notice of motion on battery energy storage systems
summary: Item 6.3 is a notice of motion by Mayor DeMarsh on Battery Energy Storage Systems, with the text in an attachment. The agenda does not say what the motion would do; a notice of motion is normally debated at a later meeting.
evidence: Notice of Motion by Mayor DeMarsh re: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

headline: OPG and CNSC updates on Wesleyville and Darlington new nuclear
summary: The committee hears a CNSC update covering Pickering, Darlington, waste facilities, the Darlington New Nuclear Project and the Wesleyville project, followed by OPG project updates on Wesleyville and Darlington New Nuclear. Presentations only; no decisions are listed.
